sources.label: Base GLDY proxy and verified GLDYTokenERC20

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Base block 52800765 (2026-10-19): GLDY proxy 0x632db1aaace73401a5dc8cde6e9062b8ec0fd819 resolves to the verified GLDYTokenERC20 implementation 0xd3a66bf0ecbf910afcc91bd2af3e724656448cb5. The implementation maps _frozen and exposes setAddressFrozen(address,bool) restricted to OPERATOR_ROLE; _update rejects a frozen sender or recipient. OPERATOR_ROLE (0x97667070c54ef182b0f5858b034beac1b6f3089aa2d3188bb1e8929f4fa9b929) currently hasRole(0xa50fc96f444c2922ca80cc7e56fd8e10633ce983)=true. whitelistEnabled() is true, so canReceive(to) also requires whitelist membership and the operator can remove a holder through removeFromWhitelist; paused() is false. Base is the only authored deployment (totalSupply 3,360.805284 GLDY), so it holds 100% of supply and is material. Direct Yes.
